subject: Skip QoS event draining when AE_FILE_EVENTS is not set (#5098)
reason: The change guards aeProcessQoSEvents in aeProcessEvents behind the AE_FILE_EVENTS flag, but every production caller already passes that flag: aeMain uses AE_ALL_EVENTS and processEventsWhileBlocked uses AE_FILE_EVENTS|AE_DONT_WAIT, and these are the only two call sites outside unit tests. The skipped-draining branch is reachable only when aeProcessEvents is called with AE_TIME_EVENTS alone, which no shipped binary (valkey-server, valkey-cli, valkey-benchmark) ever does. There is therefore no observable behaviour change in a running server for a scenario to exercise; the fix is a latent library
